page:
Growing ecosystem of tools, libraries, and integrations built on or supporting Zod natively. Resources for learning Zod, API libraries, form integrations, code generation (Zod-to-X and X-to-Zod), mocking libraries, and utilities. Focus on Zod 4 support. Submission process for new libraries via Twitter (@colinhacks) or GitHub Discussions.
- Total TypeScript Zod Tutorial by @mattpocockuk

sections.manifest: Learning resources for Zod. Total TypeScript Zod Tutorial by Matt Pocock. Runtime typechecking video by Jack Herrington. Environment variable validation guide.
API libraries built on Zod. Libraries and frameworks with native Zod support for API development.
Form integration libraries. Frameworks and libraries integrating Zod with form handling.
Zod-to-X code generation. Tools converting Zod schemas to other formats (OpenAPI, GraphQL, JSON Schema, etc.).
X-to-Zod converters. Tools generating Zod schemas from other formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Protocol Buffers, etc.).
Mocking libraries for Zod. Libraries generating mock data and test fixtures from Zod schemas.
Projects powered by Zod. Applications and services built using Zod.
Zod utilities and helpers. Third-party libraries providing extensions, convenience functions, and utilities for Zod schemas.
